conditional: Performance applies only to observable targets in PBMC, myeloid and CD4-memory T-cell coverage.
Perfect separation is an observed property of a small curated control set, not proof of generalisation.
permitted: The evaluated public cohorts separate the observable tier-1 controls under the frozen endpoint and lineage rules.
Within-study donor-paired inducibility is estimated for the reported cohorts and endpoints.
unsupported: The real benchmark validates epithelial or tissue-resident lineages.
The control benchmark has protein-level corroboration.
An abstained or non-induced target is safe.
